hypotheses.description: BTC leadership and delayed altcoin price discovery
hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: A relative BTC innovation leads the next 5m altcoin return beyond the common factor.
assumptions: synchronized spot candles measure the lag
BTC is a uniquely informative leader
required_data: Binance spot OHLCV 5m for ten pairs
hypotheses.protocol: One fixed 5m lag, equal-weight alt response, common-factor controls, pseudo-leaders, circular shift and Holm.
pause_criteria: integrity or synchronization prevents the primary contrast
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Economic effect was negative; BTC failed pseudo-leader and Holm specificity gates.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Past realized volatility predicts future magnitude because uncertainty and leverage adjust gradually.
assumptions: close-to-close RV is an adequate risk proxy
five blocks can expose concentration
hypotheses.protocol: Fixed 2h past/future RV, chronological calibration/evaluation, day bootstrap and circular placebo.
hypotheses.result: Strong risk information but failed concentration gate
hypotheses.rejection_reason: One block contributed 30.3708% of positive loss reduction, above the frozen 30% gate.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Negative semivariance adds future-risk information beyond total volatility due to deleveraging and liquidity withdrawal.
assumptions: candle semivariance is a valid signed-risk proxy
hypotheses.protocol: Fixed 2h semivariance decomposition, total-RV baseline, chronological evaluation and shifted-sign placebo.
hypotheses.result: Descriptive beta without stable incremental forecast value
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Incremental MSE CI crossed zero and one block contributed 37.58% of positive improvement.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: A same-direction co-jump propagates to assets not yet affected in the following 5m candle.
assumptions: 4x causal RMS and three same-sign assets identify a co-jump
hypotheses.protocol: Frozen event definition, one-candle response, de-clustering, costs, placebo and block bootstrap.
pause_criteria: fewer than 30 events in any block
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Three of five blocks had fewer than 30 valid de-clustered events; thresholds cannot be retuned.

hypotheses.description: Cross-sectional dispersion as a market-risk state
hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Return disagreement across assets predicts subsequent market-wide risk magnitude.
assumptions: cross-sectional dispersion captures heterogeneous information or liquidity
hypotheses.protocol: Fixed 2h dispersion, future market RV, chronological evaluation, leave-one-out and placebo.
hypotheses.result: Risk information but failed concentration gate
hypotheses.rejection_reason: One block contributed 30.3991% of positive loss reduction.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Relative laggards reverse versus the equal-weight universe.
assumptions: distinct from time-series mean reversion
hypotheses.protocol: Would require a preregistered laggard contrast without retrospective horizons.
success_criteria: positive liquid effect and holdout replication
rejection_criteria: repackages rejected mean reversion or RST04
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Would reopen rejected Mean Reversion and cross-sectional ranking on consumed data.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Low recent volatility relative to an older baseline predicts future risk expansion.
assumptions: continuous compression ratio measures the state without thresholds
hypotheses.protocol: Fixed 2h short RV versus prior 24h RV, future 2h risk, chronological evaluation and placebo.
hypotheses.result: Compression predicted persistence in the opposite direction
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Compression beta was significantly negative; no squeeze threshold may be searched.

hypotheses.description: OHLCV proxy for illiquidity and price impact
hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Low liquidity predicts higher future cost and risk.
assumptions: a candle proxy would need validation against actual spread and depth
hypotheses.protocol: Validate a preregistered proxy against microstructure data before any outcome study.
success_criteria: proxy validity and independent risk/cost prediction
rejection_criteria: proxy only captures volatility or volume
hypotheses.result: Blocked by permanent current-project data gap
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Candles cannot identify spread, depth, or realized impact.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Abnormal activity predicts future activity or risk.
assumptions: reported volume is not equivalent to institutional flow
hypotheses.protocol: Would require flow-side validation before a risk study.
success_criteria: incremental value beyond volatility and wash-trading controls
hypotheses.result: Closed by anti-recycling and data-adequacy gates
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Volume/filter family is closed and OHLCV volume cannot identify flow.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Stop-driven liquidity events create predictable overshoot or reversal.
assumptions: true stop runs require order-flow identification
hypotheses.protocol: Event study only after the event is identified independently of candle shape.
rejection_criteria: candle pattern alone is the event label
hypotheses.result: Blocked by permanent current-project data gap
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Candles cannot identify the proposed liquidity mechanism.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Participant and liquidity cycles create repeatable net time effects.
assumptions: calendar labels are ex ante but highly multiple
hypotheses.protocol: Use existing market-eligibility and walk-forward evidence; no new time-bin mining.
hypotheses.result: No temporal filter passed production consistency
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No filter improved Survival; best documented OOS PF remained below 1.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Funding and basis compensate carry and reveal crowded leveraged positioning.
assumptions: funding and basis are timestamped and economically collectible
hypotheses.protocol: Prospective carry/basis study with temporal placebo, costs and cross-asset replication.
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No funding, basis, or perp dataset exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Rising OI with extreme funding predicts leveraged unwind risk.
assumptions: OI is clean and comparable through time
hypotheses.protocol: Predefined crowding events versus future risk and matched temporal placebos.
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No OI or funding panel exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Forced liquidations generate temporary overshoot, risk, or reversal.
assumptions: liquidation events can be measured independently
hypotheses.protocol: Matched event study with volatility/time controls and prospective holdout.
rejection_criteria: events do not beat matched placebo
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No liquidation event dataset exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: One venue incorporates information before the other due to participant and leverage differences.
assumptions: spot and perp clocks are synchronized
hypotheses.protocol: Fixed-lag cross-market lead-lag with pseudo-leaders, costs and holdout.
rejection_criteria: common factor or synchronization explains effect
hypotheses.rejection_reason: Only spot OHLCV is available.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Persistent aggressive flow predicts short-horizon pressure beyond volume.
assumptions: trade side is correctly classified
hypotheses.protocol: Flow-imbalance forecast versus volume/volatility baselines and shifted labels.
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No tick/aggressor dataset exists.

hypotheses.description: Order-book depth, imbalance, and liquidity withdrawal
hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Depth withdrawal and imbalance predict fragility, slippage, or jumps.
assumptions: book snapshots are synchronized and deep enough
hypotheses.protocol: Predefined depth features versus future cost/risk and temporal placebos.
rejection_criteria: no advantage over volatility and spread baselines
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No order-book dataset exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Temporary cross-exchange price gaps persist when arbitrage is constrained.
assumptions: all fees, clocks, transfers, and inventory constraints are measured
hypotheses.protocol: Synchronized gap convergence net of executable costs and inventory limits.
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No synchronized multi-exchange or transfer-cost dataset exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Funding dispersion identifies cross-asset carry or crowding premia.
assumptions: funding is comparable across assets and exchanges
hypotheses.protocol: Predefined carry ranking versus equal-weight and rank placebo with holdout.
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No funding/carry panel exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Stablecoin inflows alter exchange liquidity and future market pressure.
assumptions: exchange labels and flow timestamps are valid
hypotheses.protocol: Prospective flow event study versus market/volume controls.
rejection_criteria: effect disappears under label or market controls
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No stablecoin flow or exchange-label dataset exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Transfers to or from exchanges precede trading pressure or risk.
assumptions: address labels are accurate and available without lookahead
hypotheses.protocol: Prospective flow study versus BTC/volume controls and label placebos.
rejection_criteria: effect is label-sensitive or leaks future information
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No on-chain flow or validated label dataset exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Unexpected macro information changes crypto return/risk distributions.
assumptions: consensus and release timestamps are precise
hypotheses.protocol: Predefined event windows versus matched clock-time placebos.
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No consensus/surprise dataset exists.

hypotheses.description: Option-implied variance, jump, and skew premia
hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Option prices reveal compensated future variance, jump, or skew risk.
assumptions: surfaces and forwards are consistently constructed
hypotheses.protocol: Predefined implied measures versus realized outcomes with maturity controls and holdout.
rejection_criteria: no realized-outcome relation out of sample
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No option surface or forwards dataset exists.

hypotheses.description: Token unlock and vesting supply shocks
hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Known free-float increases create abnormal supply pressure or anticipatory repricing.
assumptions: unlock size and circulating supply are known ex ante
hypotheses.protocol: Prospective matched event study with market-beta controls.
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No prospective unlock/free-float dataset exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Access or regulatory shocks create abnormal liquidity, risk, or returns.
assumptions: event surprise and timestamp are classified ex ante
hypotheses.protocol: Matched prospective event study with false-date placebos.
rejection_criteria: retrospective event selection or no replication
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No prospective event/surprise dataset exists.

hypotheses.economic_hypothesis: Ex ante attention or sentiment changes future activity, risk, or returns.
assumptions: publication timestamps and source provenance are leakage-free
hypotheses.protocol: One provenance-safe signal versus market controls and timestamp placebos on holdout.
rejection_criteria: effect disappears after honest timestamps or controls
hypotheses.rejection_reason: No provenance-safe sentiment dataset or prospective holdout exists.
